lines.text: Alamo Injury Law, this is Boris, the firm's AI assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help?
Hi. My old lawyer dropped my case, and I don't know what to do. I was in a rideshare that got sideswiped on 281.
I'm sorry. When was the accident?
February of last year. My shoulder still hurts. I've been in therapy on and off since.
Thank you. Since it's been a while, I'm flagging this for an attorney today. Do you have the letter from your old firm?
Good. Could you text a photo of it to this number? Grant Whitaker will call you this afternoon.
